instruction.text: What happens after visiting the doctor’s surgery? Read the text and select the matching image.

atoms.a: Karim is supposed to take cough syrup for his cold. He’s going to pick it up from the pharmacy with his dad.

instruction.text: What can you buy at the pharmacy? Select the correct statement.

cards.text: You can buy medicine such as tablets, creams, drops and syrups.

atoms.b: Medicine contains special active ingredients. They help you get better or to stay ((ill ++healthy)).
Depending on their form, they can be swallowed, inhaled or ((++injected thrown_away)).

instruction.text: What is a type of medicine and what isn’t? Sort the items.

trainers.hint: Medicine contains special active ingredients. They can be swallowed, inhaled or injected.

text: Pharmacies don’t just sell medication. They also provide certain medical supplies.
These also help you get better, but do not contain any active ingredients.

instruction.text: Read the text and find the matching item in the image.

atoms.a: The doctor gave Karim’s dad a prescription stating which medication she prescribed for Karim.
The pharmacist reads the prescription and takes the cough syrup from his stock.

instruction.text: The pharmacist is explaining to Karim how to take the cough syrup. Fill in the gaps.

atoms.b: So, Karim, ((++shake bake)) the cough syrup well before use.
Then, take a large ((forkful ++spoonful)) 3 times a day, preferably before meals.
